newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers steady amid healthy enquiries.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers steady amid healthy enquiries.

text.p: Singapore bunkers indications were unchanged on Wednesday amid healthy enquiries and tight availabilities, traders said.

They said shipowners have already entered the market for holiday supplies since Friday, and another round of buying was expected. Majors said 180-cst supplies were tight, keeping the 180/380-cst spread at $6.50 to $7.00 per tonne.
Majors offered 180-cst at $130-$132 per tonne and 380-cst at $125-$126 while independent were more aggressive at $127-$130 for 180-cst and $122-$124 for 380-cst.
MDO and gas oil were quoted at $238-$245 and $255-$263 respectively. --Singapore Newsroom (+65-870-3086)
